title: artemisia genipi subsp. eriantha
intro: Artemisia genipi subsp. eriantha, commonly known as Andean sagewort, is a subspecies of the Artemisia genipi plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues such as digestive problems, fever, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Andean sagewort include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which aid in soothing digestive issues and relieving respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
